text: Iyo akanyabiziga gasunikwa, ibyo katwaye bidatuma umuyobozi abona neza imbere ye:

options.text: Hagomba umuherekeza ukurikira ako kanyabiziga ku maguru

text: Imizigo ikinyabiziga kikoreye igomba gupakirwa no gupangwa mu buryo idashobora:
Birabujijwe kubangamira imigendere isanzwe y'ibindi binyabiziga kubera:

options.text: Gukanda feri bidateganyijwe no kwirinda impanuka

text: Imyaka yifatizo ku bayobozi b'ibinyabiziga biri mu rwego A na B ni:

options.text: A na B byombi ni byo

text: Munsi siro, umuvuduko ntarengwa ku bindi binyabiziga byose uzaba:
